instruction: Access Chrome's privacy and security settings to review your browser's protection features.

metadata.explanation: Task requires navigating to Chrome privacy and security settings. Uses existing is_expected_active_tab_approximate metric to check if the active tab URL matches chrome://settings/privacy. Similar complexity to original task - single navigation action to Chrome internal settings page.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts active tab URL from accessibility tree - appropriate for verifying Chrome page navigation
Metric appropriately checks URL match while ignoring query parameters - suitable for settings pages
Expected value 'chrome://settings/privacy' is the correct URL for Chrome privacy and security settings
Complete coverage - instruction only requires accessing the settings page, evaluator verifies exactly this
Evaluator logic semantically matches the instruction requirement
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: Accessibility tree dependency could fail if Chrome is not active - this is an environmental concern rather than a logic issue
Optional: Consider adding postconfig to ensure Chrome is focused/active before evaluation, though not strictly necessary for URL verification
